title: Daily News Quiz · 2026-08-24
headline: NASA-led study shows some Earth microbes could survive on the moon

questions.prompt: Who led the study of Earth microbes on the moon?
questions.hintKo: The lead scientist was Prabal Saxena of NASA's Goddard center.

questions.prompt: What did the NASA-led models say some Earth microbes could do?
choices: Survive for weeks to months on the moon
questions.hintKo: The finding was that some microbes could survive for weeks to months.

questions.prompt: When did the models say microbes were more likely to survive?
questions.hintKo: The models favored autumn and winter for survival.

questions.prompt: Where near the lunar South Pole could some microbes last the longest?
questions.hintKo: Permanently shadowed craters offered the best survival chances.

questions.prompt: Why do scientists worry about Earth microbes reaching the moon?
choices: They could contaminate ice, soil, and sample tests
They would make the moon too heavy
They would turn the moon green
questions.hintKo: The worry is contamination of ice, soil, and samples.

questions.prompt: How did the researchers test whether microbes could survive there?
choices: By sending them in a rocket
By modeling lunar conditions with computer data
By freezing them in a fridge
questions.hintKo: They used models based on lunar observations and data.
